description: Update an existing short URL's configuration. Only provided fields are changed — omitted fields remain unchanged. Changes apply immediately. Use after nevent_list_short_urls to get the `id`. Supported updates: title, expiresAt (pass null to remove expiration), isActive (true/false), tags (replaces existing), metadata (replaces existing), longUrl (changes redirect destination). Returns the updated ShortUrlDTO. WRITE operation — requires STANDARD or FULL operation mode. In READ_ONLY mode this tool returns an operation_not_permitted error immediately without making any API call.

expiresAt.description: New expiration date/time (ISO 8601). Pass null to remove an existing expiration and make the link permanent. Omit this field entirely to leave expiration unchanged.

id.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the short URL (24 hex characters). Obtain from nevent_list_short_urls response field "id".

isActive.description: Activate (true) or deactivate (false) the short URL. Deactivated links stop redirecting immediately.

longUrl.description: New destination URL. Changes where existing links redirect to — takes effect immediately.

metadata.description: New metadata object. Replaces (not merges) the existing metadata.

tags.description: New tag list. Replaces (not merges) the existing tags.

title.description: New descriptive title (max 200 chars). Replaces the existing title.

name: nevent_update_short_url
